identified_gaps.paper_reference: docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb (notebook references metadata_url rather than a bundled local CSV)
identified_gaps.related_workflow: C. elegans UMAP vs DenseUMAP tutorial — metadata cell.type count
execution_evidence: testing_report.missing_inputs: distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_metadata.csv (not present in repo; notebook loads metadata from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final_metadata.txt)
execution_tool_outputs: search found docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb referencing metadata_url; no local CSV under distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data present
identified_gaps.explanation: The user-specified local CSV path does not exist in the repository; the notebook loads metadata from an external raw.githubusercontent.com URL instead. This blocks reproducing the exact local-file-based workflow as requested.
identified_gaps.likely_impact: High — attempts that expect a bundled local CSV will fail; reproductions must fetch the external file or the repo must include the CSV.
identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Include the metadata CSV at distortions/notebooks/c_elegans/data/c_elegans_metadata.csv in the repo, or explicitly document and script the notebook's external download step.

identified_gaps.title: Ambiguous NaN handling produced conflicting unique-count reports (36 vs 37)
identified_gaps.paper_reference: docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb (no explicit statement whether missing/NaN cell.type values should be counted)
identified_gaps.related_workflow: C. elegans UMAP vs DenseUMAP tutorial — metadata cell.type count
execution_evidence: testing_report.observed_outputs: reported 'total 37 unique values' (sample list shown)
execution_answer.final_answer and execution_tool_outputs: executed script that drops NaNs produced '36' and printed 36 unique non-NaN cell.type values
execution_answer.chain steps: initial script hit TypeError when sorting due to NaN; final script explicitly dropped NaNs before counting
identified_gaps.explanation: There is no explicit instruction whether NaN/empty entries in 'cell.type' should be treated as a distinct category. One observed run reported 37 (likely counting a blank/NaN), while the validated execution that dropped NaNs reported 36.
identified_gaps.likely_impact: Medium — changes the numeric answer for 'how many unique cell types' and can produce inconsistent results between runs.
identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Specify in the notebook (and any evaluation scripts) whether to include or exclude NaN/blank cell.type entries; when counting, use an explicit dropna() or fillna() policy and document it.

identified_gaps.title: Platform-fragile shell heredoc and transient path issues during validation
identified_gaps.paper_reference: docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb (validation commands invoked via scripts/one-shot heredoc in testing harness)
related_repo_files: testing harness commands listed in testing_report.commands_run
identified_gaps.related_workflow: C. elegans UMAP vs DenseUMAP tutorial — metadata cell.type count
execution_evidence: testing_report.runtime_errors: Initial attempted heredoc command failed on Windows shell: '<< was unexpected at this time.'
testing_report.runtime_errors: earlier python invocation used wrong relative path and failed due to duplicated 'workspace' in path (transient execution path issue)
identified_gaps.explanation: Some of the validation invocation patterns used (heredoc, particular relative paths) are brittle on the Windows runner used for execution, causing transient command failures even though the underlying analysis is simple.
identified_gaps.likely_impact: Low — does not prevent reproduction if commands are run in a platform-appropriate way, but increases friction and risk of spurious failures in automated runs.
identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Provide platform-robust invocation examples (avoid shell-specific heredoc in cross-platform docs) and use explicit relative/absolute paths in scripts.

execution_gaps: Platform-fragile shell heredoc and transient path issues during validation

recommended_followups: Add the metadata CSV to the repo path requested or clearly document and script the notebook's external download so local-file-based workflows succeed without manual fetching.
Clarify NaN/blank handling for the 'cell.type' column in the notebook and evaluation scripts; re-run the count with the documented policy to remove the 36 vs 37 ambiguity.
Update tutorial invocation examples to be cross-platform (avoid shell heredoc) and fix example paths to avoid transient path duplication errors.
gap_report.notes: Despite the missing local CSV, the team validated the cell.type count by downloading the notebook's external metadata URL; validated execution (with dropna) produced 36 unique non-NaN cell.type values. Testing_report contained an earlier observation of 37 which likely reflects a different NaN-inclusion policy.

gate_decision.reasoning: A high-severity missing_artifact (local CSV absent) prevents reliably reproducing the exact requested load and the worker did not demonstrably run the local-file workflow, so the numeric claim cannot be trusted.
